obfuscation_indicators: impact discussed throughout Results of Operations
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and well quantified, with detailed merger, capital, liquidity, and credit-loss impacts. Risk tone is mildly negative because of COVID-19 disruption, macroeconomic deterioration, and sharply higher provisions, but strong earnings and capital ratios provide counterbalancing confidence. Some standard cross-references and offsetting language limit clarity on the underlying drivers and forward-looking effects.
